Explicit provider model catalogs no longer include unsupported bundled models or reuse stale entries after refresh failures. (#49135)
Clarified how provider credentials use the configured storage backend and how `env_key` identifies the API-key environment variable. (#49118)
Reduced repeated plugin-loading work by caching parsed manifests and reusing HTTP connections for remote plugin requests. (#49099, #49100)

title.zh-TW: 使用 ChatGPT 登入本機時，可收到帳號安全設定提醒
title.en: Receive Account Security Reminders When Logging In with ChatGPT Locally

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣在終端機裡用 ChatGPT 帳號登入來協助寫程式，遇到帳號防護尚未齊全時，畫面會適時跳出提示。在符合條件的本機工作階段（session，在電腦端與 AI 連線互動的執行過程）中，現在能主動顯示選用的提醒訊息，引導你前往完成帳號安全設定。⟦像大樓的門禁管理處，以前只要出示識別證就直接放行，現在若發現你的證件還沒補齊聯絡資料，會在通過閘門時順手遞上一張便條提醒你抽空登記。⟧ 這項提示屬於非強制的選用通知，讓你在本機使用工具的同時，也能隨時注意到自己帳號的防護狀態，依提示補齊安全設定。
body.en: If you typically log in with your ChatGPT account in the terminal for coding assistance, the screen now displays a timely prompt when your account protection is not fully configured. In eligible local sessions, optional reminder messages can now appear proactively to guide you through completing your account security setup. ⟦Picture a building security desk that previously let you straight through whenever you showed your badge, but now hands you a note at the gate if it spots missing contact details, reminding you to register when you have time.⟧ This prompt is a non-mandatory optional notice, allowing you to stay aware of your account protection status while using tools locally and complete security settings as prompted.

items.original: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行背景與沙盒指令不再跳出黑視窗閃爍
title.en: Background and Sandboxed Commands on Windows No Longer Flash Black Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Codex 處理專案時，工作節奏不再會被突如其來的畫面閃爍打斷。以前每當它在幕後啟動背景行程（在後台運作而不佔用畫面的程式）時，螢幕常會瞬間閃現黑框。執行沙盒指令（被限制在安全隔離環境中執行的指令）時也會出現同樣的彈窗干擾。現在 Codex 啟動這些背景任務時，跳出主控台（console，顯示純文字指令的介面）視窗的閃爍問題已經被修好。⟦像舞台助理在布幕後方安靜搬運道具，不會每次走動就突然拉開簾子干擾台前的表演。⟧
body.en: When working on projects with Codex on Windows, your workflow is no longer interrupted by sudden screen flashing. Previously, whenever it spawned background processes behind the scenes, black command prompt windows would often flash across the screen. Running sandboxed commands caused the same popup disruptions. Now, the flashing issue caused by popup console windows when Codex launches these background tasks has been fixed. ⟦Picture a stage assistant moving props quietly behind the curtains without pulling them open to disrupt the performance on stage every time they move around.⟧

items.original: Suppressed console windows flashing on Windows when Codex launches background processes and sandboxed commands. (#49385)
Added `←`/`→` shortcuts to `/config`: on a highlighted setting they switch to the previous or next value and save it right away, without opening the dropdown, and the footer shows a `←/→ Change` hint

Improved responsiveness in long conversations in no flicker (altscreen) mode: resizing the terminal no longer freezes or lags the CLI, the full-screen view redraws the messages on screen first instead of showing text wrapped for the old width until the whole conversation has re-rendered, and interrupting the agent with `Esc` or resuming a conversation no longer re-renders every step already on screen.

Improved mouse text selection in the `altscreen` view and in the artifact viewer: dragging past the top or bottom now auto-scrolls, the selection stays on its text while the agent streams or you scroll with the wheel, and copying includes lines that scrolled off screen, without line numbers or comment previews from the artifact viewer

Improved the always-allow suggestion when approving `go` commands: approving a command such as `go vet` or `go build` now offers to allow that subcommand with any arguments, while `go run`, `go test`, `go generate`, `go install`, and `go tool` still require the exact command

Improved the `Send Immediately` option for Queued Messages in `/config`: a message you send while earlier messages are still queued now goes to the agent together with them, in order, instead of joining the queue, and a message that fails to send mid-turn goes back to the queue instead of being lost

Changed how the agent generates images: it now hands image requests to a built-in `image-generator` subagent, which writes the prompt, checks each result with up to three attempts, and saves the images to the conversation's artifacts, so image generation appears as a subagent run in the conversation

Fixed the agent stalling when a background command it was waiting on crashed or was killed by the system, for example when it ran out of memory; the agent now sees the command finish with its exit code, such as `137` or `134`, and keeps going
Fixed headless `-p` runs sometimes exiting before the agent could respond to a background command that finished after its first turn

Fixed `k` in Vim Normal mode recalling the last history entry instead of your queued messages when pressed on the top line, which could send a queued message twice; `k` now pulls queued messages back into the editor like the `Up` arrow does

Fixed `skills.json`, `rules.json`, and other customization manifests in a parent `.agents/` directory being ignored when a session started in a subdirectory; manifests now load from every `.agents/` directory between the working directory and the project root
Fixed the `/` menu listing built-in skills that the current agent does not enable, which inserted instructions for tools the agent could not use when selected
Fixed settings failing to load when `~/.gemini/config/config.json` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as files saved by Notepad or PowerShell `Set-Content` on Windows do
Fixed slash-command output and alerts where a line exactly as wide as the terminal had its last word pushed to the start of the next line without indentation
Added prebuilt native Android binaries of the CLI that can run directly in Termux, without requiring a proot-distro environment.
Improved responsiveness while typing, scrolling, and streaming agent output by sharply reducing the memory the CLI allocates on every update and redraw
Improved `-p "/usage"` to show quota reset times in your local time zone when printing to a terminal; piped and `--json` output still use UTC timestamps, so existing scripts are unaffected

Improved the always-allow suggestion when approving `repo` commands: it is now limited to the subcommand, such as `repo status`, instead of allowing every `repo` command, matching `git`, `hg`, and `jj`

Improved how the agent handles a permission request that is not approved, such as one raised by a subagent that cannot ask you: it now respects the denial and no longer tries to work around it with other commands, scripts, or tools

Fixed the conversation view freezing for the rest of the session, with no new steps appearing while the agent kept working, after redraws such as several quick terminal resizes in a long conversation; the CLI now reconnects automatically, warns only if reconnecting fails, and sending a new message recovers a lost connection

Fixed requests made after your plan quota is used up and your AI credits balance cannot cover them: instead of retrying on `Working...` for about two and a half minutes and then showing the generic "Agent execution terminated due to error.", the CLI now immediately says "Your AI credits balance is too low to continue."

Fixed text like `Ga=q,f=32,s=1,v=1,i=31;AAAAAA==` being left behind in macOS Terminal.app after exiting the CLI over SSH; the CLI now asks the terminal to identify itself before probing for image support, and over SSH only Kitty and Ghostty are treated as image-capable, so WezTerm and Konsole no longer show garbled image placeholders

Fixed the Vim mode cursor stopping inside emoji such as 👩‍💻 or ⚠️ and characters with combining marks such as Devanagari: `h`, `l`, and other motions now move over whole characters, and `x` and `r` delete or replace the whole character instead of a hidden part of it
Fixed the search box in the `/resume` conversation picker wrapping long queries so that their beginning scrolled out of view; the box now uses the full terminal width

Fixed the agent being blocked from reading your global rules and customization files in `~/.gemini/config`, including the `rules/` folder, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `plugins.json`, and `agents.json`; it can now read them and asks before editing them, while other files in that folder stay off-limits
Fixed global rules being added to the agent's context more than once when `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`, `~/.gemini/AGENTS.md`, or their `~/.gemini/config/` counterparts are symlinks to the same file
Fixed signing in to MCP servers whose OAuth client registration responds with HTTP `200` instead of `201`, which previously failed with `registration failed with status 200`
Fixed large WebP images opened by the agent not being scaled down to fit image size limits the way PNG and JPEG images are

title.zh-TW: 設定選單新增排隊選項，可隨時插話打斷對話
title.en: Settings Menu Adds Queue Option to Interrupt Conversations Anytime

body.zh-TW:
當你看到助理正朝錯誤方向執行長任務時，現在可以直接插話叫停。⟦跟看著助手搬錯箱子時直接出聲喊停一樣，以前只能等他把整批貨搬完才能交代新指令，現在一開口就能立刻打斷他。⟧你可以在 `/config` 選單找到 `Queued Messages` 選項。保持預設的 `Queue` 會把補充訊息暫存到當前輪次結束，切換成 `Send Immediately` 則能立即中斷助理。這項偏好也能直接寫入全域設定檔 `settings.json`，修正了以往寫入該設定卻被系統忽略的問題：
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```
body.en:
When you see your assistant heading in the wrong direction during a long task, you can now speak up and stop it directly. ⟦Think of calling out to stop a helper carrying the wrong box: previously you had to wait until the entire shipment was moved to issue new instructions, but now you can interrupt immediately.⟧ You can find the `Queued Messages` option in the `/config` menu. Keeping the default `Queue` buffers follow-up messages until the current turn ends, while switching to `Send Immediately` interrupts the assistant right away. This preference can also be written directly to the global configuration file `settings.json`, fixing an issue where writing this setting previously got ignored by the system:
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```

items.original: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

title.zh-TW: Linux 容器環境支援遠端控制，沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員也能背景啟動
title.en: Remote Control Now Supported in Linux Containers, Starting in Background Without systemd User Service Manager

body.zh-TW: 當你在輕量 Docker 環境裡想要連線操作時，過去常因底層缺少自動託管機制而直接碰壁卡關。⟦彷彿在沒有自動排班系統的小型倉庫裡改由工人手動輪值，雖然當機時不會自動重啟、開機也不會自動執行，但依然能把手邊的工作順利跑起來。⟧在沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員（替個人帳號管理背景服務的程式）的 Linux 機器上執行 `remote-control start` 時，現在會直接將常駐程式以背景行程啟動，並警告該行程當機後不會自動重啟且開機時不會自動載入。你隨時能輸入 `remote-control status` 查詢其行程識別碼（PID），需要結束時輸入 `remote-control stop` 即可將其關閉。
body.en: When you want to connect and operate inside a lightweight Docker environment, you previously hit a wall because the underlying system lacked an automated hosting mechanism. ⟦Picture running a small warehouse without an automated scheduling system by having workers take manual shifts: although it will not automatically restart on crashes or launch on boot, it still keeps your current work running smoothly.⟧ When running `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager (a program that manages background services for a user account), the daemon now starts directly as a background process, warning that the process will not restart on crash or launch on boot. You can enter `remote-control status` anytime to check its process ID (PID), and enter `remote-control stop` whenever you need to shut it down.

items.original: Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down

title.zh-TW: 長對話載入更快，缺步歷程不再覆寫舊進度
title.en: Long Conversations Load Faster, and Histories with Missing Steps No Longer Overwrite Old Progress

body.zh-TW: 當你接續聊了很久的繁重工作階段，或是中途遇上當機想接回紀錄時，整個流程順暢且安心許多。⟦如同翻開厚重日記時直接跳到最新的書籤頁，不必每次都從第一頁逐字掃描，就算中間曾掉了一頁，後續記錄也絕不會錯位覆蓋。⟧重啟擁有數千步驟的對話時，命令列介面不再預先逐步掃描，載入速度明顯加快。歷程若曾因當機或寫入中斷而出現遺漏步驟，恢復時不會再隱藏最新內容，更不會讓新訊息意外覆寫舊紀錄。自動產生的對話標題現在也會將首則訊息附加的圖片與檔案納入考量，純傳截圖或檔案的請求也能擁有具體的標題。
body.en: When you resume a heavy, long-running session or reconnect to your history after a crash, the entire workflow is noticeably smoother and safer. ⟦A reader opening a thick journal jumps straight to the newest bookmarked page without scanning word-by-word from the start, ensuring later entries never misalign or overwrite old notes even if a page went missing.⟧ When restarting conversations with thousands of steps, the command-line interface no longer pre-scans step-by-step, significantly speeding up load times. If history was missing steps due to crashes or interrupted writes, resuming will no longer hide the latest content, nor will new messages accidentally overwrite old records. Auto-generated conversation titles now also factor in images and files attached to the first message, giving concrete titles to requests that only include screenshots or files.

items.original:
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front
Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 帳號違規遭封鎖時，登入錯誤提示附上申訴連結
title.en: Login Error Prompts Include Appeal Links When Accounts Are Blocked for Violations

body.zh-TW: 早上一開工卻被擋在門外，畫面上只寫著因違反服務條款（Terms of Service）遭到停權，常讓人不知道該去哪裡詢問。以前遇到帳號受阻只能看見失敗提示，摸不清該找誰處理；現在登入失敗的錯誤訊息裡會直接附上申訴連結，讓你能立刻點擊網址提交說明。⟦就像門禁卡突然失效時，感應機不再只發出逼逼警告聲，而是直接在螢幕上顯示管理室的服務電話與分機。⟧
body.en: Starting your morning only to find yourself locked out, with a screen stating your account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Service, often leaves you wondering where to turn. Previously, encountering a blocked account only showed a generic failure message with no clear contact point; now, login failure error messages directly include an appeal link, letting you click the URL immediately to submit an explanation. ⟦Instead of merely beeping when an access card fails, a card reader now displays the management office phone number and extension directly on its screen.⟧

items.original: Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

title.zh-TW: `--json-schema` 啟動時嚴格檢查，根層級非物件立即報錯
title.en: `--json-schema` Strictly Validated at Startup, Failing Immediately If Root Level Is Not an Object

body.zh-TW: 當你為指令傳入結構描述時，若格式有誤或檔案遺失，系統在啟動階段就會立即攔截。⟦好比海關在登機門前嚴格核對護照格式，發現拿的是白紙、寫錯代碼或缺件就當場拒絕通行，而不是放行登機後才引發混亂。⟧參數 `--json-schema` 不再將純文字、單獨型態名稱（如 `string`）或不存在的結構描述檔默默當成字串型態處理。現在只要輸入上述無效內容，或是根層級不是物件（`"type": "object"`）的結構描述，程式在啟動時就會直接輸出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 `1` 中斷退出。
body.en: When you pass a schema to a command, the system now intercepts formatting errors or missing files right at startup. ⟦Customs officers strictly check passport formats at the boarding gate, turning away blank paper, mistyped codes, or missing documents on the spot rather than causing chaos after boarding.⟧ The `--json-schema` parameter no longer silently treats plain text, bare type names (such as `string`), or non-existent schema files as string types. Supplying any of these invalid inputs, or a schema whose root level is not an object (`"type": "object"`), now causes the program to output an error message at startup and exit immediately with exit code `1`.

items.original: Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示不再游標偏離，表情符號與特殊文字換行不割裂
title.en: Prompt Input Eliminates Cursor Drift, Keeping Emojis and Complex Characters Intact Across Line Wraps

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特殊字元或在多重視窗中作業時，游標位置與文字折行現在能精準對齊。⟦就像使用排版工具編輯圖文，以前遇到複雜貼圖或組合文字時游標會飄到半空中、換行還會把圖案切成兩半，現在游標與字元邊界都緊緊貼合。⟧修復了在提示列輸入 ⚠️ 或 👩‍💻 等表情符號，以及天城文（Devanagari）與泰文等組合字元時游標尾端偏離的問題，特別是在 `tmux` 環境下更是如此。當文字過長自動折行時，也不會再將這類特殊字元拆散切成兩行顯示。
body.en: When entering special characters in the terminal or working across multiplexed windows, cursor positioning and text wrapping now align precisely. ⟦Like laying out text and graphics in a publishing tool where complex stickers previously floated the cursor into mid-air and line breaks sliced graphics in half, the cursor and character boundaries now fit tightly together.⟧ Fixed trailing cursor drift when entering emojis such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, as well as combining characters like Devanagari and Thai in the prompt line, especially inside `tmux` environments. When long text wraps automatically, it will also no longer split these special characters across two lines.

items.original: Fixed the prompt cursor drifting away from the end of the text after emoji such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari and Thai, especially inside `tmux`, and fixed prompt wrapping splitting such characters across two lines

title.zh-TW: 檢視管線裝置與損毀影音不再卡死，事前攔截並清楚提示
title.en: Inspecting Pipe Devices and Corrupted Media No Longer Hangs, Intercepting Early with Clear Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當助理嘗試讀取特殊系統檔案或不完整的影音錄影時，對話不會再陷入無止境的等待或報錯。⟦宛如播放器遇到未下載完成的影片或特殊資料通道時直接提示檔案損毀，而不是整台機器當機轉圈圈。⟧以前助理若嘗試檢視管線（pipe）、通訊端或裝置檔等特殊檔案，流程很容易直接卡死。檢視未錄製完整的 MP4、MOV 或 M4A 影音檔時，對話也會陷入無效引數（`INVALID_ARGUMENT`）錯誤而無法繼續。現在遇到這兩類檔案時，系統會在讀取前直接攔截並給出明確的提示訊息。
body.en: When the assistant attempts to read special system files or incomplete audiovisual recordings, conversations no longer get trapped in endless waiting or error states. ⟦A media player encountering an incomplete video download or a special data stream alerts you to file corruption directly instead of freezing the entire machine with a spinning wheel.⟧ Previously, if the assistant tried to inspect special files such as pipes, sockets, or device files, the process easily hung completely. Inspecting incompletely recorded MP4, MOV, or M4A media files also threw `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors that blocked the conversation from continuing. When encountering either type of file, the system now intercepts before reading and provides a clear prompt.

items.original: Fixed the agent hanging when it tried to view a pipe, socket, or device file, and a conversation getting stuck with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors after the agent viewed a truncated MP4, MOV, or M4A recording; both are now rejected up front with a clear message

title.zh-TW: 接回舊對話與狀態列即時提醒，快取過期成本一目了然
title.en: Resuming Old Conversations with Real-Time Status Line Alerts Makes Cache Expiration Costs Clear

body.zh-TW: 當你暫停工作後想接續先前任務，常因快取（暫存計算結果的機制）過期而重送大量資料。開啟進度管家後，只要以 `/resume`、`--resume` 或 `--continue` 接回過期且脈絡達 5 萬 token（AI 計費的文字單位）的對話，Claude Code 會在輸入首句前顯示一行提示，列出閒置時間、預估重送的 token 數並建議先執行 `/compact`。此提示僅自己可見且不計入脈絡，需 2.1.251 以上版本且下次啟動 usage 自動套用。狀態列在倒數結束後也不再留白，到期當下會即時重畫，顯示如 `cold·re-cache 180k` 的提示，表示下一則訊息約有 18 萬 token 要重新快取。⟦如同退房時櫃檯即時試算加時費用，以前超時往往結帳才發現驚人帳單，現在一到超時點就主動亮出補收標準，讓你能提前評估是否精簡內容。⟧
body.en: When resuming previous tasks after taking a break, users often resend large amounts of data due to expired caches. With Progress Manager enabled, whenever you resume an expired conversation with at least 50k tokens of context using `/resume`, `--resume`, or `--continue`, Claude Code displays a single-line notice before you enter your first prompt. This notice details the idle duration and the estimated number of tokens to resend, while suggesting that you run `/compact` first. Visible only to you, this prompt is excluded from context, requires version 2.1.251 or later, and applies automatically the next time usage launches. The status line also no longer goes blank when the countdown ends. Instead, it redraws immediately upon expiration to show prompts like `cold·re-cache 180k`, indicating that the next message will re-cache approximately 180k tokens. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk calculating overtime charges the moment checkout passes: instead of discovering a surprise bill at final settlement, you immediately see the extra fees and can decide in advance whether to trim your stay.⟧

items.original:
**Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.
**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完改播專屬短音，告急提醒更具辨識度
title.en: Distinct Chimes for Dwindling Quotas Make Low-Quota Alerts Instantly Recognizable

body.zh-TW: 埋頭趕工或專注思考時，如果沒有時常緊盯著用量面板，額度（特定週期內可使用的調用配額上限）見底的瞬間往往讓人猝不及防。現在系統調整了通知音效，當額度快用完或已經用完時，會改播 usage 自製的兩聲「uh-oh」簡短警示音，讓你光聽聲音就能分辨用量告急。至於額度恢復時的通知，則繼續維持播放系統預設的提示音，避免干擾既有的使用習慣。⟦洗衣機遇到排水故障時用短促警示，洗好衣服則播放一般完成音；現在額度告急有專屬短音，額度恢復仍是系統預設音，光聽就能分辨。⟧
body.en: When rushing through work or deep in thought, running out of quota without watching the usage popover can easily catch you off guard. The system has now updated its notification sounds. Whenever quota is running low or fully exhausted, usage plays a custom two-tone "uh-oh" short alert, letting you recognize the urgent status by sound alone. Notifications for quota recovery continue to play the default system chime, preserving your established workflow habits. ⟦A washing machine beeps with a sharp warning when drainage fails but plays a standard completion chime when the cycle finishes smoothly. In the same way, quota exhaustion now triggers a dedicated short tone while recovery uses the default system sound, making them distinguishable by ear alone.⟧

items.original: Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理輸出少算問題，歷史快取自動重新結算
title.en: Fixing Undercounted Subagent Outputs and Automatically Recalculating Historical Caches

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫多個背景助手平行處理繁重任務的使用者，過去看到的用量統計可能嚴重失真。先前在串流（答案一邊生成一邊逐字傳輸的輸出方式）處理時，Claude Code 會把同一請求多次寫入日誌，導致解析器只抓到第一行，使子代理的輸出用量少算約 86%。例如在某台機器上的 17 個子代理日誌中，原本僅記錄到 23,327 個輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），修正後改取每筆請求的最大值，實際數值應為 165,395。這項問題只影響子代理，主對話日誌完全不受影響；更新後歷史快取與年度快取會自動重算一次，但日誌已遭刪除的日期則維持封存數字無法補正。⟦好比收銀機結帳時印出整串明細，以前系統只抓取了剛開始印出的第一行小計，導致整筆交易總額嚴重短少；現在改以最終印出的加總金額為準，歷史紀錄重新結算後用量數字終於回歸真實。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to spawning multiple background assistants for parallel tasks may have previously seen severely skewed usage statistics. During streaming responses, Claude Code wrote the same request to logs multiple times. This caused the parser to capture only the first line, undercounting subagent output usage by about 86%. For example, across 17 subagent logs on one machine, only 23,327 output tokens were initially recorded; after switching to taking the maximum value per request, the actual count was 165,395. This issue affected only subagents, leaving main session logs completely untouched. After the update, historical and annual caches are automatically recalculated once, though dates whose logs were deleted remain archived and cannot be retroactively fixed. ⟦Think of a cash register printing a long receipt where the system previously captured only the first line of subtotal, causing the recorded total to fall drastically short. By taking the final printed sum instead, historical records are recalculated and usage numbers reflect reality at last.⟧

items.original: **Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表補上 Sonnet 5.5，名稱顯示不再截斷
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Adds Sonnet 5.5 and Fixes Truncated Model Names

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線環境工作時，最怕計費工具因連不上伺服器而無法正確計算新型號的花費。現在離線備援（主要機制失效時接手的後備清單）價目表正式補上了新模型資料，完整納入 `claude-sonnet-5-5` 的費率。以前當下載的線上價目表過期時，這款模型的用量會被誤算為 0 美元；現在即使離線也能依正確標準計價，終端機表格中也會顯示為清晰的「Sonnet 5.5」，不再出現被截斷的模型識別碼。⟦彷彿隨身攜帶的紙本價目表補齊了最新熱門品項，以前網路斷線時查不到新餐點價格會直接被當成免費招待，現在備援清單完整對齊，就算離線結算也不會漏算費用。⟧
body.en: When working offline or during network outages, cost tracking tools often fail to price new models accurately without server access. The offline fallback pricing table now officially incorporates new model data, fully including rates for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Previously, when the downloaded online pricing expired, usage for this model was miscalculated as $0. Now it is priced correctly even offline, and terminal tables clearly display "Sonnet 5.5" rather than a truncated model identifier. ⟦Like a printed menu updated with the newest popular dishes, where disconnected servers previously treated unknown items as free on the house, the fallback list is now fully aligned so offline calculations never miss a charge.⟧

items.original: Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板字級對齊其他主題，專案明細不再偏小
title.en: ECG popover font sizes align with other themes so project details are no longer undersized

body.zh-TW: 當你切換到心電圖面板追蹤用量時，專案清單與底部的文字讀起來更協調了。⟦像看銀行寄來的對帳單，以前總額底下的一筆筆明細被印得特別小，上下對照總覺得比例失調；現在各欄位字級調整一致，一眼望去就能看清每筆收支。⟧以前在這個主題中，專案名稱、token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數、金額、專案動作按鈕、狀態列、今日金額與頁尾按鈕，字級原本都比平常小了 1 到 3px。這些文字放在大號額度讀數下方時顯得很突兀，現在心電圖面板的專案用量與頁尾字級已調回正常大小，與其他主題保持一致。
body.en: When you switch to the ECG popover to track usage, text across the project list and bottom section now reads with greater visual balance. ⟦Picture reviewing a bank statement where individual line items below the total were previously printed unusually small, creating an awkward visual contrast; now all fields share a consistent font size so you can clearly scan every expense at a glance.⟧ Previously in this theme, project names, token counts, costs, project action buttons, the status bar, today's total, and footer buttons were all 1 to 3px smaller than usual. That text looked out of place beneath the large quota readout, but project usage and footer font sizes in the ECG popover have now been restored to their standard scale, staying consistent with all other themes.

items.original: Bring the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer text up to the size every other theme uses. Project names, token counts, costs, the project actions, the status strip, today's total and the footer buttons were 1–3px smaller and looked out of place under the large quota readouts.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板重整專案用量與頁尾，按鈕即時連動狀態列設定
title.en: ECG Popover Reorganizes Project Usage and Footer with Real-Time Status-Line Sync

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機裡查看各專案的資源消耗時，現在心電圖面板能呈現更工整清晰的排版。⟦如同走進重新規畫的控制室，以前各項指標高低不一且按鈕各自為政，現在所有數值按欄位整齊排好，開關指示燈也直接與主系統連線同步。⟧心電圖面板的專案列已改為對齊的數據表，搭配細長條與外框名次標籤，讓用量多寡與排行一目了然。原本的三個專案動作整合成一組分段按鈕，按鈕亮起狀態會跟著真正的 status-line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）設定走，避免顯示與背後設定脫節。底部頁尾換上精簡的狀態列樣式，而上方的額度卡片則維持原本外觀。
body.en: When checking resource consumption across projects in the terminal, the ECG popover now presents a cleaner, more organized layout. ⟦Picture stepping into a redesigned control room: where scattered meters and isolated switches once operated independently, all readings are now arranged in aligned columns and indicator lights stay in sync with the main system.⟧ The project rows in the ECG popover are now structured into an aligned data table with slender bars and boxed rank tags, making usage levels and rankings clear at a glance. The previous three project actions are consolidated into a segmented button group, and the active button state mirrors the actual status-line configuration to prevent display mismatch. The bottom footer adopts a streamlined status-line style, while the quota cards above retain their original appearance.

items.original: Tidy the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer: project rows line up as a data table with thin bars and outlined rank chips, the three project actions form one segmented control whose lit state follows the real status-line setting, and the footer becomes a status strip. The quota cards keep their original look.

title.zh-TW: 說明文件與官網展示收錄手繪筆記與心電圖新主題
title.en: Documentation and Website Add Handdrawn and ECG Theme Previews

body.zh-TW: 想在挑選主題前先預覽介面外觀，現在不必親自安裝切換就能直接看見效果。⟦好比走進線上家具型錄，以前新推出的配色沒有附上實景展示，想看搭配只能買回家組裝；現在目錄首頁就放上情境輪播，一眼就能比對每套風格的實際質感。⟧說明文件裡的 README 主題展示（theme gallery，列出各種外觀風格的範例區）與官方網站的面板輪播，現在同步收錄了「手繪筆記」與「心電圖」兩款樣式。你可以在網頁上直接看清不同主題在面板上的排版細節，挑選順眼的風格後再套用到終端機環境中。
body.en: When previewing interface styles before picking a theme, you can now see the results directly without installing and switching themes yourself. ⟦Like flipping through an online furniture catalog where new color schemes previously lacked room previews and required assembling them at home, the homepage now provides an interactive carousel to compare the exact look of every style at a glance.⟧ The README theme gallery in the documentation and the popover carousel on the official website now include both the "Handdrawn" and "ECG" themes. You can inspect layout details across themes directly on the web and pick your favorite style before applying it to your terminal.

items.original: Add Sketchbook and Heart Monitor to the README theme gallery and to the website's panel carousel.

title.zh-TW: 修復四處安全漏洞，防範非預期檔案寫入與驗證被繞過
title.en: Fix Four Security Vulnerabilities to Prevent Unexpected File Writes and Verification Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 下載、安裝技能或驗證產物時不再受惡意名稱所害，建議盡快升到 `v2.102.0`。`gh release download`、`gh run download`、`gh repo read-file --output` 與 `gh attestation download` 遇目的地含符號連結（指向其他位置的捷徑檔）時，以前可能寫入非預期的本機檔案。`gh attestation verify` 以前比對 `--source-ref` 不分大小寫，且 `--signer-workflow` 只比憑證身分開頭，僅大小寫不同的分支，或同儲存庫內路徑開頭相同的另一個工作流程，都可能通過驗證。互動式 `gh skill search` 傳路徑給 `gh skill install` 時缺少選項分隔符號，搜尋結果可能注入安裝選項並改寫檔案位置。⟦就像同一棟樓四扇門的鎖被一次補好。⟧
body.en: Downloading artifacts, installing skills, or verifying attestations is no longer vulnerable to malicious names, and upgrading to `v2.102.0` as soon as possible is recommended. When the destination contains a symlink, `gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` previously risked writing to unintended local files. `gh attestation verify` previously compared `--source-ref` case-insensitively and only matched the prefix of certificate identities for `--signer-workflow`, allowing branches differing only by case or another workflow with a matching path prefix in the same repository to pass verification. Interactive `gh skill search` lacked an option delimiter when passing paths to `gh skill install`, which allowed search results to inject installation options and alter file locations. ⟦Picture locks on four doors of the same building being fixed all at once.⟧

items.original:
## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.
